title: The Core Generator (JIT Engine Architecture)

title: Arbitrary Value Parsing (JIT Engine Architecture)
description: The generator uses Advanced Regex Pattern Matching (AST) to evaluate utility classes. It natively supports important modifiers (e.g. `!pl-10`), properly escaping them to generate robust overriding styles (like `.\!pl-10`).

title: Configuration Resolution (JIT Engine Architecture)
